## Primaquine regimens by G6PD status

| G6PD status | Policy on PQ | Additional safety |
|---|---|---|
| **G6PD Normal** | PQ 0.5 mg/kg over 7 days | Patient counselling, VMW Follow-up on day 3 and 7 at patients homes |
| **G6PD Intermediate** | PQ 0.75 mg/kg weekly for 8 weeks | Patient counselling, VMW Follow-up once a week at patients homes |
| **G6PD Deficient** | PQ 0.75 mg/kg weekly for 8 weeks | Patient counselling, VMW Follow-up once a week at patients homes |

## Notes

Changed to 7-day PQ in 2023
